Solara — (9.0) THE ONE

SPEED OF DAWN

"Speed of dawn"

[Verse 1]

The message came before the morning settled

A voice through the frequency of stars

Vega the Harp was sending something broken

A signal fracturing from far

She said: the new ones are going dark

Not slowly

Not in cycles

Not the way a star sets into rest

One by one they stop

And something moves where they were

And the dark that follows

Is a different kind of dark

Than anything I’ve seen

[Pre-Chorus]

I did not wait for the council

I did not sit with the law

I looked at Castor

Who was already standing

And I called Nemesis through the door:

Bring your ledger

We are going now

The Hollow is not building anymore

It is eating

[Chorus]

Speed of dawn

We move before the light knows we are coming

Speed of dawn

Across the planes and into the consuming

Nemesis on my left

And Castor on my right

And somewhere in the dark ahead

Vega was still sending light

Speed of dawn

Three of us against the nothing

Speed of dawn

And every second costs a something

I have felt it breathing

Now I need to see its face

Speed of dawn

Let us reach her

Before it takes her place

[Verse 2]

The next plane felt like held breath

Like a room that something large

Had just moved through and stopped

The new stars were not gone

Not all of them

But some were dark in places

Where I felt them from the top

And Nemesis was counting

Writing numbers as we ran

And Castor kept his eyes ahead

The way only Castor can

And then I heard it

Vega the Harp still singing

The last measures of a song

That sounded like a call

Like someone playing everything they knew

So that someone else would hear it

From across the hall

[Pre-Chorus 2]

And I said: there

And we moved faster

And the Hollow at the edge

Pulled like cold

And Nemesis grabbed my arm and said:

It knows we’re here

And I said:

Good

[Chorus]

Speed of dawn

Three of us against the nothing

Speed of dawn

And every second costs a something

I have felt it breathing

Now I need to see its face

Speed of dawn

Let us reach her

Before it takes her place

[Bridge — they arrive. They see her.]

She was still there.

Vega the Harp.

Still playing.

Still bright.

Still sending the signal.

And she turned toward me

And I saw the relief in her light

And she opened her mouth

To say something

Something I almost heard

And then

The Hollow moved

And Vega

Was not there anymore

And the song stopped

In the middle of the word

She was going to say

And the silence

Where Vega had been

Was a different kind of silence

Than any silence I had held before

And Castor said nothing

And Nemesis closed the ledger

And I stood at the edge of where she was

And I understood

For the first time

What ending the Hollow actually means

It means this

Never again

[Final Chorus — slower, certain, no longer racing]

Speed of dawn

We came as fast as the light allows us

Speed of dawn

And the Hollow still outran us

But I saw her

I heard her

I know what she was going to say

Speed of dawn

Will not be fast enough next time

Speed of dawn

But there will not be a next time

I am The One

And I have seen its face now

And I know what ending it will take

Speed of dawn

Vega

I heard your song

[Outro — SOLARA turns back toward the garden. Castor walks beside her. Nemesis opens the ledger again.]

The debt is now personal.

She was playing

When the Hollow took her.

I remember the song.

I will finish it.
